brief: A wall clock with hands that turn and tell the time.

requirements.evidence: No part, accessory, insert, port, prop, or socket in the catalog provides a clock movement, dial, or hands; searches for clock, dial, time, motor returned nothing. Placed nothing.
Hex Cluster has no actuated or timekeeping parts; configurator checks fit only and cannot drive motion.
Without a movement and hands, time cannot be told.

finish.summary: Declined: Hex Cluster has no clock movement, hands, dial, or any timekeeping function, so a working wall clock cannot be built with these tools. A static hex-shaped wall decoration could be built, but it would not turn or tell time. Fit a bought quartz clock movement through a cover instead, outside this configurator.

pack.why: the build has no printed parts.

events.text: Building a working wall clock — starting the hands-on setup.
